title: First Week Home
prompt: I just brought my baby home from the hospital. Can you walk me through what to expect in the first week? What are the most important things I should focus on? I'm feeling nervous and excited.

title: Starting Solids
prompt: I think my baby is ready to start solids. Can you guide me through how to begin? What signs should I look for, what foods to start with, and how to make it a positive experience?

title: Your Emotions
prompt: My emotions have been all over the place during pregnancy/postpartum. Can you help me understand what's normal, what's hormones, and when I should pay closer attention to how I'm feeling?

title: Baby Sleep Guide
prompt: I want to understand baby sleep — wake windows, naps, night sleep, the regressions everyone talks about. Can you walk me through what's realistic for my baby's age and gentle ways to build a peaceful routine?

title: Breastfeeding
prompt: I have so many questions about breastfeeding — latching, supply, pumping, whether to combo feed. Can you help me figure out what's working, what's not, and what my options are without any judgment?

title: Postpartum Recovery
desc: Your body and mind after birth
prompt: I want to understand what postpartum recovery actually looks like — the physical healing, the hormones, the emotional adjustment. What's normal, what's not, and how do I take care of myself through it?
